title: TD Power Systems Ltd. (NSE: TDPOWERSYS) — Company Dossier
primer: TD Power Systems raised FY2027 revenue guidance to ₹2,900–₹3,000 Cr, set FY2028 at ₹3,400–₹3,500 Cr, and lifted H1 CFO to ₹211.74 Cr. Even so, business quality stays CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL due to US tariff risks, +35% receivables, Siemens Energy build-to-print reliance, and Oxbow selling. On 2026-11-25 (₹587.05 vs ₹605.30 ledger), shares entered STAGE_4 (CAP_REJECTED), so new capital is REJECTED (TIER_0). Our 470-share holding sells 235 shares immediately (~₹587) and exits the rest into ₹601–₹615 or below ₹545.00.
holding_rationale: De-risk our 470-share Zerodha holding (6.67% weight on 2026-11-23 ledger; ₹636.52 avg cost; ₹2,75,913.50 live value at ₹587.05) in two tranches. First, sell 235 shares (50%) immediately at market (~₹587.05). That halves Stage 4 weight to ~3.3% and cuts unhedged 6.56%-ATR gap risk in half. Second, exit the remaining 235 shares into broken 200D SMA (₹601.31) and 40W EMA (₹608.25) resistance at ₹601–₹615 (alert ₹605.00). Alternatively, exit immediately on a daily close below our ratcheted ₹545.00 hard stop (up from ₹520.00). Waiting for ₹620+ across all 470 shares carried an unfavorable 0.78:1 bounce-versus-stop ratio in confirmed STAGE_4 (CAP_REJECTED).

holding_alerts.instruction: Exit all remaining 235 shares immediately to cap residual incremental downside (-7.16% from ₹587.05, -₹9,882 on 235 shares) ahead of the ₹485 S2 air pocket.

holding_alerts.instruction: Re-underwrite only if quarterly revenue hits ₹725–₹750 Cr, U.S. tariff/Turkey routing clears cleanly, receivables stabilize, and the weekly chart reclaims Stage 2.

redeployment_plan.capital_source: Proceeds from the two-tranche 470-share exit (235 shares immediate at ~₹587 = ~₹1.38 lakh + 235 shares into ₹601–₹615 bounce = ~₹1.41–₹1.45 lakh, or ~₹2.76–₹2.83 lakh total) plus any next marginal cash unit.

destinations.rationale: Active India shortlist names such as COFORGE and ZYDUSLIFE sit in healthier Stage 2 structures, but reallocation should occur at the next portfolio-level audit on a verified support pullback rather than forced from a single-stock exit.
destinations.entry_condition: Deploy only after a portfolio-level audit confirms support-zone entry asymmetry on a Stage 2 candidate.

destinations.recommendation: No outside equity candidate is funded.
destinations.rationale: Electrical-equipment peers Cummins India and CG Power are also in Stage 4 markdowns, and no outside name is funded without full 10-chapter underwriting.
destinations.entry_condition: Fund only after a complete monograph clears fundamental, valuation, and Stage 2 technical gates.

destinations.recommendation: Retain 100% of exit proceeds and marginal capital in cash.
destinations.rationale: TDPOWERSYS is in confirmed Stage 4 markdown, peer capital-goods names are under distribution, and India market breadth remains narrow (48.2% above 200DMA). Cash preserves optionality.
destinations.entry_condition: Redeploy into verified Stage 2 leaders at defined support zones during the next portfolio audit.

horizons.rationale: Confirmed Stage 4 breakdown (CAP_REJECTED) on 2026-11-25 at ₹587.05—below 200D SMA (₹601.31), 50D SMA (-17.39%), 30W SMA (-11.84%), and 10W EMA (-11.12%), with 7 distribution days, -40.04% 28D RS, and no 4H turn.

Upgraded FY27 (₹2,900–₹3,000 Cr) and FY28 (₹3,400–₹3,500 Cr) guidance and ₹211.74 Cr H1 CFO are positive, but U.S. tariff/Turkey routing, +35% receivables jump, and QIP deployment require 2 quarters of proof.
Strong ROCE (34.0%) and Siemens Energy 4th-plant framework show OEM trust, but build-to-print single-OEM IP dependency, cyclical history, and lumpy cash conversion keep compounding unproven.
